title: Re-review t8u after its NOT READY review's blocking findings (round 2)
description:
Review the epic t8u again, AS INTEGRATED, now that the blocking findings of its NOT READY review are fixed. This is review round 2; 2 count toward the bound of 2.

The previous review (r6v, decision 22) judged it NOT READY: make epic/t8u's CI green by fixing fn8's ref-lock guard hook for git >= 2.51 (hold only the first prepared transaction; fix verified on git 2.56), and meet [A1] with a recorded before/after full-suite measurement, which needs internal/reconcile's full suite cut, or have the operator re-scope A1 on t8u.; its blocking finding(s): "fn8's ref-lock guard deadlocks on git >= 2.51; epic CI red since 9a34b1001"; "A1 unmet: the full suite's floor, internal/reconcile, did not get faster".

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what still blocks it. A NOT READY that spends the bound is not reviewed again by the run unless the tree changes after it: it holds for a person with your reasons.
